item.title: [Episode 17] The AI Brain Awakened at the DMZ ([17화] 휴전선에 깨어난 인공지능의 뇌)
item.description:
[Episode 17] The AI Brain Awakened at the DMZ ([17화] 휴전선에 깨어난 인공지능의 뇌)

☞ View from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introduction (☞ 등장인물 소개)

In early December, the area near the DMZ in Goseong, Gangwon Province, becomes a vacuum where time stands still. Only the air of the Arctic Ocean, which freezes even the dust, surrounds the barbed-wire fence. (12월 초 강원도 고성의 휴전선 인근은 시간이 멈춘 진공 상태가 된다. 흙먼지조차 얼어붙게 만드는 북극해의 공기만이 철책선을 감싼다.)

Evan's team arrived at the South Korean military's DMZ surveillance equipment operations room near Goseong before dawn for a live demonstration of Sariel. (에반 일행은 사리엘 라이브 데모를 위해 새벽부터 고성 부근 한국군 DMZ 감시 장비 운용실에 도착했다.)

Just 5 kilometers down from the operations room, a completely different world unfolds. Instagram-worthy cafés are springing up like mushrooms against the backdrop of the serene sea, and couples are scattered everywhere taking认证 shots. (운용실에서 불과 5㎞만 내려가면 전혀 다른 세상이 펼쳐진다. 인스타용 카페들이 고요한 바다를 배경으로 우후죽순 영업 중이고, 커플들은 여기저기 퍼져 인증샷을 남긴다.)

But one night, over a decade ago, time in front of this fence was marked by disgrace. It was the scene of the 'knock defection' that no one knew about until a North Korean soldier crossed the triple fence and knocked on the guard post's door. At the time, surveillance equipment was down, and human eyes were closed due to accumulated fatigue. (하지만 십수 년 전 어느 밤, 이곳 철책 앞의 시간은 치욕으로 남겨졌다. 북한군 병사가 삼중 철책을 넘고 소초 문을 두드릴 때까지 그 누구도 몰랐던 ‘노크 귀순’의 현장. 당시 감시 장비는 먹통이었고, 인간의 눈은 누적된 피로 탓에 감겨 버렸다.)

Evan was attempting to plant the eyes of artificial intelligence over this scar hidden by daily life. (에반은 일상으로 가려진 이 흉터 위에 인공지능의 눈을 심으려 하는 것이었다.)

The server room, running on a constant temperature and humidity controller, felt cool and dry. (항온항습기가 돌아가는 서버실은 공기가 서늘하고 건조했다.)

Evan, wearing anti-static gloves, stared at the bottom of the server rack. The main backplane slot was in the deepest spot, an awkward position that defied human posture. Without hesitation, he lay down on the cold floor mat, twisted his shoulders, and pushed his upper body into the narrow rack. A faint warmth, mixed with fine dust and a burnt smell, unique to machinery, wafted toward him. (에반은 정전기 방지용 장갑을 낀 채 서버 랙 최하단을 응시했다. 메인 백플레인 슬롯은 가장 깊숙한 곳, 인간의 자세를 거부하는 고약한 위치였다. 에반은 주저 없이 차가운 바닥 매트 위에 엎드려 어깨를 비틀어 좁은 랙 안쪽으로 상체를 밀어 넣었다. 미세한 먼지와 탄 냄새가 섞인, 기계 특유의 미지근한 숨결이 끼쳐왔다.)

His eyes followed the slender guide rails. A sound signaled a precision fit that allowed no margin of error—not even 1 millimeter. He held his breath for a moment. Lying down, his back muscles tensed taut, but the fingertips supporting the heavy matte black module showed no tremor. The cold sweat on his forehead evaporated instantly in the heat from the fan blowing out from deep inside the rack. (가느다란 가이드 레일을 눈이 쫓았다. 1㎜의 오차도 허용하지 않는 정교한 결합을 알리는 소리가 났다. 잠시 숨을 멈췄다. 엎드린 자세로 등 근육이 팽팽하게 당겨졌지만, 묵직한 무광 검정색 모듈을 받친 손끝에는 떨림이 없었다. 랙 깊숙한 곳에서 뿜어져 나오는 팬의 열기에 이마의 식은땀이 금세 증발했다.)

Behind Evan, who came with him, Jordan, the South Korean Minister of National Defense, and Director Park Gwan-gyu began quietly flipping through evaluation documents. (에반과 함께 온 조던의 등 뒤에서 한국 국방부 장관과 박관규 실장이 조용히 평가 서류를 넘기기 시작했다.)

Jordan, twirling a silver-white hardware key between his fingers, lightly patted Evan on the shoulder after he finished his work. (조던은 은백색 하드웨어 키를 손가락 사이로 돌리다, 작업을 마친 에반의 어깨를 가볍게 쳤다.)

"Evan, this job really can't be done without you. There are plenty of people who churn out hardware, but only you can turn it into a living god in the field." (“에반, 역시 이 일은 자네가 아니면 안 돼. 하드웨어를 찍어내는 놈들은 널렸지만, 그걸 현장에서 살아 있는 신으로 만드는 건 너뿐이니까.”)

Jordan leaned toward the Director and the Minister and added, (조던이 박 실장과 장관 쪽으로 몸을 기울이며 덧붙였다.)

"Minister, I heard you often emphasize 'act first, report later.' Now you can sleep soundly at night. Sariel will finish that preliminary action far faster and far more accurately than you could." (“장관님, 평소 ‘선조치 후보고’를 강조하신다고 들었습니다. 이제 밤엔 편히 주무셔도 됩니다. 사리엘이 장관님보다 훨씬 빠르고, 훨씬 정확하게 그 선조치를 끝내놓을 테니까요.”)

Instead of replying, Evan pushed the module all the way into the slot. (에반은 대답 대신 모듈을 슬롯 끝까지 밀어 넣었다.)

Click. (딸깍.)

The cold metallic sound cut through the server room's silence. The dedicated optical cable connected directly to the high-bandwidth memory (HBM), and Sariel's neural network awakened. Evan got up from his lying position and sat down at the keyboard, not even bothering to brush the dust off his knees. (차가운 금속음이 서버실의 정적을 갈랐다. 전용 광케이블이 고대역폭 메모리(HBM)와 직결되며 사리엘의 신경망이 깨어났다. 에반은 엎드렸던 몸을 일으켜 무릎의 먼지를 털지도 않은 채 키보드 앞에 앉았다.)

"Booting up." (“부팅합니다.”)

Evan pressed the Enter key without hesitation. Thousands of lines of code poured onto the black screen. Sariel was not just a simple surveillance camera. It was a massive brain that reconstructed in real time the data from all thermal imaging equipment, CCTVs, and ground vibration sensors in the base. (에반이 망설임 없이 엔터키를 눌렀다. 검은 화면 위로 수천 줄의 코드가 쏟아졌다. 사리엘은 단순한 감시 카메라가 아니었다. 기지의 모든 열상 장비, CCTV, 지면 진동 센서의 데이터를 실시간으로 재구성하는 거대한 뇌였다.)

[SYSTEM INITIALIZING...] ([SYSTEM INITIALIZING...])

[DEEP-LEARNING PATTERN MATCHING: ENABLED] ([DEEP-LEARNING PATTERN MATCHING: ENABLED])

[NEURAL RECONSTRUCTION: ACTIVE] ([NEURAL RECONSTRUCTION: ACTIVE])

Pfft—. (팟—.)

The screen lit up. The entire DMZ, previously pitch black, came vividly alive in a contrast of jade green and red. (화면이 켜졌다. 칠흑 같던 DMZ 전역이 비취색과 붉은색의 대비로 선명하게 살아났다.)

"Minister, look. This isn't an estimate. It's a fact computed by the algorithm." (“장관님, 보십시오. 추정이 아닙니다. 알고리즘이 연산해낸 사실입니다.”)

Evan zoomed in on one area of the screen. (에반이 화면의 한 구역을 확대했다.)

It was a North Korean forward guard post 3 kilometers away. It was nighttime without a single light, but Sariel had perfectly removed the noise, rendering 4K-quality imagery. In the front yard of the post, five or six North Korean soldiers were moving piles of cabbage. (3㎞ 밖 북한군 전방 초소였다. 빛 하나 없는 야간이었지만 사리엘은 노이즈를 완벽히 제거해 4K급 화질을 구현해 냈다. 초소 앞마당에서 대여섯 명의 북한군이 배추 더미를 옮기고 있었다.)

"You can even see them making kimchi. But Sariel isn't looking at the cabbage." (“김장 담그는 것까지 다 볼 수 있습니다. 하지만 사리엘이 보는 건 배추가 아닙니다.”)

A data analysis window popped up beside the screen. (화면 옆으로 데이터 분석 창이 떠올랐다.)

"By analyzing the quantity and brine state of the cabbage, it calculates in real time the supply level and even the current number of personnel stationed at this post. By combining the changes in the supply truck's suspension height with the soldiers' movements, it can even predict the calorie count of tonight's meal." (“배추의 양과 절임 상태를 분석해 이 초소의 보급 수준과 현재 주둔 인원까지 실시간으로 역산합니다. 보급 트럭의 서스펜션 높이 변화와 병사들의 움직임을 종합하면, 오늘 저녁 식단의 칼로리까지 예측 가능합니다.”)

Just as the Minister was about to adjust his glasses, Evan switched the screen. (장관이 안경을 고쳐 쓰려는 찰나, 에반이 화면을 전환했다.)

A deep brush area of the DMZ. A faint heat source was detected that, with ordinary equipment, would have been dismissed as a branch shaking in the wind or a roe deer. Sariel overlaid a sharp red target box on it. (DMZ 깊은 수풀 지역. 일반 장비였다면 바람에 흔들리는 나뭇가지나 고라니로 처리됐을 미세한 열원이 포착되었다. 사리엘은 그 위에 날카로운 붉은색 타깃 박스를 씌웠다.)

The thermal image captured a human form crouched in the bushes, repeating strange movements. Sariel detected the soldier's muscle contraction patterns and minute upper body tremors based on heart rate and displayed them in red data next to the screen. (열상으로 잡힌 인간의 형체가 덤불 속에 웅크린 채 기이한 움직임을 반복했다. 사리엘은 병사의 근육 수축 패턴과 심박수에 따른 미세한 상체 떨림을 감지해 화면 옆에 붉은 데이터로 표시했다.)

[Target Status: NON-HOSTILE] ([Target Status: NON-HOSTILE])

[Activity: Physiological Relief] ([Activity: Physiological Relief])

"This is a soldier masturbating." (“자위 중인 병사입니다.”)

A cough broke out among the audience. Evan continued unfazed. (좌중에서 헛기침이 터졌다. 에반은 개의치 않고 이어갔다.)

"Sariel scans muscle movements and changes in blood flow to the extremities in real time. It instantly determines whether this action is an ambush for infiltration or personal relief." (“사리엘은 근육의 움직임과 신체 말단부의 혈류량 변화를 실시간으로 스캔합니다. 이 동작이 침투를 위한 매복인지, 개인적인 욕구 해소인지를 순식간에 판단합니다.”)

Evan pointed his finger at the red dot on the screen. (에반이 화면 속 붉은 점을 손가락으로 가리켰다.)

"If that soldier had picked up a weapon and assumed a firing posture, the unmanned turret would have finished shooting before the Minister even received the report." (“만약 저 병사가 총기를 파지하고 격발 자세를 취했다면, 장관님이 보고를 받기도 전에 무인 포탑이 사격을 마쳤을 겁니다.”)

The sound of the Minister swallowing dryly mixed into the silence. (장관의 마른침을 삼키는 소리가 정적 속에 섞였다.)

Evan stood leaning against the server rack, staring at the red target on the screen. (에반은 서버 랙에 기대어 서서 화면 속 붉은 타깃을 응시했다.)

"When Sariel puts a red dot on something, that means death is already confirmed. It takes less than a second to finish the action." (“사리엘이 붉은 점을 찍으면, 그건 이미 죽음이 확정된 겁니다. 조치를 끝내는 데 1초도 걸리지 않습니다.”)

Evan turned to the Minister and said quietly, (에반이 장관을 돌아보며 낮게 말했다.)

"Minister, you just need to wake up in the morning and sign the action reports that Sariel drafted overnight." (“장관님은 아침에 일어나셔서 사리엘이 밤새 작성한 처리 보고서에 서명만 하시면 됩니다.”)

As the live demo ended, Evan left the server room and entered an empty room at the end of the hallway. While Sentinel's technical team set up their equipment, personnel from Duyadel were barred from accessing the server room. (라이브 데모가 끝나자, 에반은 서버실에서 나와 복도 끝 빈 방으로 들어갔다. 센티넬 측 기술진이 장비를 세팅하는 동안 듀다엘 인원은 서버실 접근이 금지됐다.)

The heating at the Goseong GOP didn't reach the hallway. Evan sat on a folding chair, fidgeting with a lukewarm can of coffee. Then, as if remembering something, he pulled out his smartphone. When the screen lit up, he saw three texts from Irina piled up. (고성 GOP의 난방은 복도까지 닿지 않았다. 에반은 접이식 의자에 앉아 미지근한 캔커피를 만지작거렸다. 그러다 무언가 기억해 냈다는 듯 스마트폰을 꺼내 들었다. 화면이 켜지자 이리나의 문자가 세 통 쌓인 것을 확인했다.)

[Irina 14:42] Are you doing it right now? Don't tremble. You'll do well. ([Irina 14:42] 지금 하는 중이야? 떨지 마. 넌 잘할 거야.)

[Irina 15:33] Is it over? If it's not, read this later. Not trying to bother you. ([Irina 15:33] 끝났어? 안 끝났으면 이건 나중에 봐. 방해하려는 거 아님.)

[Irina 16:11] I heard it's really cold there. I thought about buying you hot cocoa, but Gangwon-do is too far, so I gave up. Instead, when you come up to Seoul, I'll warm you up myself. Come back soon. ([Irina 16:11] 거기 진짜 춥다며. 핫초코 사다 놓을까 했는데 강원도는 너무 멀어서 포기. 대신 서울 올라오면 내가 직접 데워줄게. 빨리 와.)

Evan felt the corner of his mouth lift. This woman presses someone's spine with her knee during security ops, but in texts, she writes things like this. (에반은 입꼬리가 올라가는 걸 느꼈다. 이 여자는 경호 현장에서 사람의 척추를 무릎으로 누르면서도, 문자에는 이런 말을 쓴다.)

He typed a reply. (답장을 쳤다.)

[Evan 16:24] It's over. Looks like it went well. I want to see you soon. ([Evan 16:24] 끝났어. 잘된 것 같아. 빨리 보고 싶어.)

After sending it, he realized the last sentence felt unusually corny for him, but he didn't delete it. (보내고 나서 마지막 문장이 평소 모습답지 않게 낯간지럽다는 걸 알았지만, 지우지 않았다.)

When he turned off the screen, his own face reflected on the black glass. Evan took a sip of the canned coffee and, unconsciously, reached into the inside pocket of his jacket. His fingertips touched metal. A CIB badge. He didn't remember putting it in there. The thought that hadn't come to mind an hour ago when he said, "When Sariel puts a red dot on something, that means death is already confirmed," surfaced in the silence of the empty room. 0.5 seconds. In Fallujah, a human finger determined that 0.5 seconds. (화면을 끄자 검은 유리 위로 자신의 얼굴이 비쳤다. 에반은 캔커피를 한 모금 마시고, 무의식적으로 점퍼 안쪽 주머니에 손을 넣었다. 손끝에 금속이 닿았다. CIB 배지. 언제 넣어뒀는지 기억나지 않았다. 한 시간 전 “사리엘이 붉은 점을 찍으면 이미 죽음이 확정된 겁니다”라고 말할 때는 떠오르지 않았던 것이, 빈방의 정적 속에서 올라왔다. 0.5초. 팔루자에서는 그 0.5초를 사람의 손가락이 결정했다.)

His thumb traced the embossed lettering on the badge once more. Then he withdrew his hand. He picked up the canned coffee. The warmth was fading. The screen lit up again. He confirmed that Irina's last text was still there. (엄지가 배지의 양각 글씨를 한 번 더듬었다. 그리고 손을 뺐다. 캔커피를 집어 들었다. 온기가 사라지고 있었다. 화면이 다시 켜졌다. 이리나의 마지막 문자가 그대로 남아 있는 것을 확인했다.)

Footsteps from the Sentinel technical team echoed from beyond the hallway. Evan drained the can and stood up. (복도 너머에서 센티넬 기술진의 발소리가 들렸다. 에반이 캔을 비우고 일어섰다.)

item.title: UNC Says North Korea Gave Advance Notice of Fence Construction… No Signs of Heavy Weaponry Being Brought In (유엔사 측 “北, 철책 공사 사전통보… 중화기 반입 정황 없어”)
item.description:
UNC Says North Korea Gave Advance Notice of Fence Construction… No Signs of Heavy Weaponry Being Brought In (유엔사 측 “北, 철책 공사 사전통보… 중화기 반입 정황 없어”)

A senior official from the United Nations Command stated regarding North Korea's installation of fences near the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) that "there are no signs of North Korea bringing heavy weapons or drones into the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ)," and added, "As long as mines and fences remain on the northern side of the MDL and no heavy weapons are introduced to disrupt the military balance between the two Koreas, it does not constitute a violation of the Armistice Agreement." Similar to South Korean forces, who provide prior notice for maintenance activities within the DMZ, North Korea also reportedly notified the UNC multiple times in advance about its fence construction. <<> In a phone interview with this newspaper on the 23rd, the official said, "While it is true that construction work on the North Korean side is progressing at a more active pace than before, we must consider the context that South Korean forces are also currently carrying out over 30 projects in the DMZ, including road construction, fence building, and tree removal." The implication is that since South Korean forces have also conducted fence construction in the DMZ, it is difficult to single out North Korean operations as problematic. <<> The official stated, "We have inspected some areas, but no (North Korean structures or mines) have crossed over to the southern side." He also noted, "Some areas require further investigation," and made it clear that if North Korean mines encroach upon the MDL or if heavy weapons or drones are brought into the DMZ, action would be taken in accordance with the Armistice Agreement. <<> Despite this authoritative interpretation by the UNC, South Korea's Ministry of National Defense stated on the 23rd, following a similar statement on the 22nd, that the North Korean military's fence construction constitutes a "clear violation of the Armistice Agreement." This marks the first time since North Korea began turning the MDL into a de facto border in 2024 that the Ministry has raised the issue of the Armistice Agreement. <<> Within and outside the military, there is speculation that this shift reflects an attempt by the government and ruling party—who seek joint exercise of the UNC's jurisdiction over the DMZ—to create public sentiment that "the UNC controls South Korea's activities in the DMZ while neglecting the North Korean military." In a separate interview with this newspaper, former UNC Deputy Secretary of the Military Armistice Commission Michael Bosack said, "There is a possibility that by fostering a perception that the Armistice Agreement is no longer valid, the South Korean government aimed to build justification for securing full authority and control over the southern part of the DMZ." <<> When asked about this, the senior UNC official responded, "I will not speculate on why the South Korean Ministry of National Defense is calling this a violation of the Armistice Agreement. I will not give a political answer." However, he added, "In the past, there have been many instances where South Korean forces placed fences within several meters of the MDL. If the South Korean Ministry of National Defense insists on Armistice Agreement violations, it should consider the possibility that it too could become subject to close scrutiny." <<> The official stated, "It is important for the UNC to maintain consistency and political neutrality, as this has been a factor in bringing North Korea to the negotiating table." This is interpreted as emphasizing the need to preserve the UNC channel, currently the only official communication route. He also noted, "The UNC may not be perfect, but it is a system that has maintained peace for the past 73 years." (유엔군사령부 고위 관계자가 북한의 군사분계선(MDL) 인근 철책 설치와 관련해 “북한이 중화기나 무인기 등을 비무장지대(DMZ) 내로 반입한 정황은 없다”며 “지뢰·철책이 MDL 북측에 남아 있고, 중화기 등을 반입해 남북 군사 균형을 깨뜨리지 않는 한 정전협정 위반은 아니다”라고 말했다. DMZ 내 보수 활동 등을 사전 통보하는 한국군과 마찬가지로, 북한도 철책 건설 등에 대해 수차례 유엔사에 사전 통보를 했다고 한다.)
